summary: Testing complete for GROUPE YAMA+ e-commerce platform. Tested currency converter API (rates, conversion, formatting), product page appointment button logic (only shows for automobile/immobilier categories), category page subcategory filters, and homepage navigation. All features working correctly.

issues.description: Rate limiting (100 requests/60 seconds) is aggressive and affects automated testing. Tests hitting the API in quick succession get 429 errors. Consider increasing rate limit for testing or adding test-specific bypass.

No automobile or immobilier products exist in the database to test the appointment button feature. The APPOINTMENT_CATEGORIES logic is correctly implemented but cannot be fully tested without sample data.

action_items: Consider adding test automobile/immobilier products to verify appointment button appears correctly for those categories
Consider increasing rate limit for testing environment or adding IP whitelist for test runners

currency_api_rates.details: GET /api/currency/rates returns XOF, EUR, USD rates with proper structure

currency_api_convert.details: POST /api/currency/convert correctly converts between XOF, EUR, USD

currency_api_format.details: GET /api/currency/format/{amount} formats prices with correct symbols (FCFA, €, $)

currency_selector_frontend.details: Currency selector displays XOF default, allows switching to EUR/USD, persists selection

product_page_appointment_button.details: Appointment button NOT shown for electronique products (only for automobile/immobilier)

product_page_action_buttons.details: Add to cart, wishlist, WhatsApp order, price alert buttons visible for regular products

category_page_filters.details: Category pages display subcategory filter buttons (Smartphones, TV, Climatiseur, etc.)

homepage_navigation.details: Homepage loads correctly, navigation to category pages works

paydunya_payment_methods.details: GET /api/payments/paydunya/methods returns Wave, Orange Money, Card, etc.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency API is fully tested and working. Product page appointment button logic is correctly implemented - only shows for automobile/immobilier categories. Rate limiting (100 req/60s) can cause test failures if tests run too quickly. PayDunya payment methods endpoint works. No automobile/immobilier products exist in DB to test appointment button visibility for those categories.
rca_of_issue: Currency API 404 error was fixed by E1 - the prefix was changed from '/api/currency' to '/currency' in currency.py to avoid double-prefixing. The fix is working correctly.
